Title: 491367-2026: Italy – Architectural and engineering services and planning-related services – TENDER PROCEDURE ON BEHALF OF THE DIOCESE OF OPPIDO MAMERTINA - PALMI. AWARD OF TECHNICAL SERVICES FOR SEISMIC SAFETY WORKS ON THE BASILICA MADONNA DEI POVERI. CUP: F86J22000220006
Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: Seismic safety measures on a basilica include structural design, execution planning and site supervision and are therefore relevant for sbp (cultural, structurally demanding heritage project). Deduction due to location in Italy and presumably limited/heritage-related scope compared to large bridge or hall projects.
titel: Award of technical planning services for seismic safety measures on the Basilica Madonna dei Poveri in Seminara
kurzbeschreibung: For the Basilica Madonna dei Poveri in Seminara (Diocese of Oppido Mamertina-Palmi), technical planning services (preliminary design, execution design, site supervision and health and safety coordination) for seismic upgrading and restoration were awarded under the PNRR.
wettbewerb_art: Award of architectural and engineering services (design competition based on the most economically advantageous tender)
gewinner: RTI ENGINEERING GROUP SRL (lead) – ACALE SRL – RELEVO S.R.L. – STUDIO DI GEOLOGIA
gewinner_rolle: Planning team for architectural, engineering and geological services (project design, execution design, site supervision, safety coordination)
gewinner_kontakt: Contract sum for planning services: 57.998,96 EUR (excluding VAT)
projektbeteiligte:
- Città Metropolitana di Reggio Calabria – public contracting authority on behalf of the Diocese of Oppido Mamertina-Palmi
- Diocese of Oppido Mamertina-Palmi – client / owner of the basilica
- ENGINEERING GROUP SRL – lead designer (architecture/engineering services), Enna, IT, engroup.srl@pec.it, Tel. +39 0935 575700
- ACALE SRL – planning office, Ancona, IT, info@pec.acale.it, Tel. +39 071 35287
- RELEVO S.R.L. – planning/engineering office, Corciano, IT, relevoitalia@pec.it, Tel. +39 075 6079724
- STUDIO DI GEOLOGIA – geology office, Santa Teresa di Riva, IT, geolnicita@gmail.com, Tel. +39 338 3209093
relevanzbewertung_begruendung:
- Small to medium-sized cultural building project (basilica) with a focus on seismic upgrading
- Pure planning and site supervision services already fully awarded
- Location in southern Italy, limited strategic added value for sbp compared to larger international landmark projects
- Structural design is an integral part of the awarded service package, therefore hardly any starting point for subsequent collaboration with the winner
checking_engineer_begruendung:
- Not a German project, therefore not a classic checking engineer market for sbp
- Relatively low fee or project size (planning contract approx. 58 thousand EUR), corresponding limited construction volume
- No explicit tender for independent checking services apparent
- Heritage/existing building with seismic upgrading is technically interesting, but is likely locally regulated and small in volume
baukosten_erklaerung: No reliable information in the text; the construction volume cannot be derived in a serious way from the planner’s fee (approx. 58 thousand EUR).
naechste_schritte: No active steps recommended. Only passively monitor the project; for future larger PNRR cultural building projects in Italy, possibly specifically look out for independent structural or checking services.
notes: Scope of services includes PFTE, execution design, site supervision and safety coordination for seismic safety measures on a basilica under the Italian PNRR programme (Missione 1, Cultura 4.0, Investimento 2.4). Award criterion: most economically advantageous tender with weighting 70 % technical / 30 % price.
